recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, textured portrait of a figure viewed through hammered or rippled glass, creating a stippled, impressionistic effect. The composition features a dark, moody background with a vibrant red and gold subject, paired with a right-aligned stack of condensed, high-contrast serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured distortion vs. sharp typographic edges
Warm subject tones vs. cool dark background
Repetitive vertical text stack vs. organic central figure
coreInvariants: Black header bar with centered wide-set text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central figure in profile, occupying the left and middle thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red glow on the right side of the figure and the large stacked text block on the far right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top black header, moves down the textured figure, and settles on the rhythmic repetition of the right-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space in the upper left and far right margins.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for background and header.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red and warm gold for the subject and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue and white highlights within the figure's jewelry/texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows against a very low-value, desaturated background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed modern serif with high stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top header uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with rounded corners.

treatment.fill: solid color (red to yellow gradient effect)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed serif and ultra-wide geometric sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast of the main text.
Matches the wide, technical feel of the header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an impressionist portrait of a figure in profile, viewed through heavily textured hammered glass. Use a palette of deep black, fiery red, and golden yellow. The figure should be on the left, leaving dark space on the right. Include a solid black bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical stack of right-aligned text in an extra-condensed modern serif font. The text should alternate between red and yellow. In the top black bar, center a wide-set geometric sans-serif word with letters colored red, blue, and yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the glass texture stippled and organic?
Is the main text block strictly right-aligned?
Does the header text have wide tracking?
Are the serifs on the main text thin and horizontal?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of red to yellow in the figure
Number of repetitions in the text stack
mustRedesign: Exact catalog numbers in the top right

mustAchieve: Tactile, painterly quality in the image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the background texture doesn't obscure text legibility
Verify the top header bar is solid black
Confirm right-alignment of the main text block
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, glass-distorted portrait with a rhythmic, vertically-stacked condensed serif layout for a vintage jazz aesthetic.
